title: What If You Got 560 Euros a Month, No Strings? Finland Tried It

scenes.text: What if the government paid you every month, no strings attached? Finland tried it.
From 2017, 2,000 randomly chosen unemployed Finns got 560 euros a month for two years.
No conditions, and the money wasn't cut if they found work or earned extra.
Did they stop working? The researchers found very little difference in employment between the groups.
But wellbeing changed: recipients reported higher life satisfaction and less mental strain, depression and loneliness.
The researchers added a warning: with no baseline survey, they couldn't prove the money caused it.

description:
What if the government paid you every month with no strings attached?
Finland tested it on 2,000 people. Work barely changed, but reported wellbeing rose.
